निपः,
 
-पम् A water-jar. 
-पः The Kadamba tree.

निप(पा)ठः, निपठनम्, निपठितिः
f. Reading, reciting, studying.

€1P. 
__1 To fall or come down, descend, alight, sink down; निपतन्ती पतिमप्यपातयत् [[

.]] 
__2 To be cast at, be directed towards; निपेतुरन्तःकरणैर्नरेन्द्राः [[

.]] 
__3 To throw oneself down (as at the feet), fall prostrate; देवास्तदन्ते हरमूढभार्यं किरीटबद्धाञ्जलयो निपत्य [[

.]] 
__4 To fall or descend into, meet in; त्वय्येव निपतन्त्योघा जाह्नवीया इबार्णवे [[

.]] 
__5 To fall upon, attack, rush at or upon; सिंहो शिशुरपि निपतति मदमलिनकपोलभित्तिषु गजेषु [[

.]] 
__6 To happen, occur, take place, fall to one's lot; सकृदंशो निपतति [[

.]] 
__7 To be placed, occupy a place; अभ्यर्हितं पूर्वं निपतति. 
__8 To flow in, discharge into. 
__9 To fall into ruin. 
__10 To fall into (any state). 
__11 To be miscarried (as the foetus). -Caus. 
__1 To cause to fall down, throw or hurl down. 
__2 To kill, destroy; तातं निपात्य सह बन्धुजनाक्षितोयैः [[

.]] 
__3 To inlay, emboss. 
__4 To direct (the eyes) upon. 
__5 To spit out. 
__6 To raise or levy (as a tribute). 
__7 (In gram.) To put down as a special or irregular form, to mention as an irregular formation; एते पञ्चविंशतिरजन्ता निपात्यन्ते [[Sk.]]

__1 Falling down, descending, alighting. 
__2 Flying down.
__1 Falling or coming down, descending, alighting; पयोधरोत्सेधनिपातचूर्णिताः [[

]]; [[Ṛs. 5. 4.]] 
__2 Attacking, falling upon, a spring, leap; उत्पश्यतः सिंहनिपातमुग्रम् [[

.]] 
__3 Casting, hurling, discharging; स च त्वदेकेषुनिपातसाध्यः [[

.]] 
__4 Descent, fall; निशितनिपाताः शराः [[Ś. 1. 10.]] 
__5 Dying, death; आनिपाताच्छरीरस्य युक्तो वार्यनिलाशनः [[

.]] 
__7 An irregular form, irregularity, putting down as irregular or exceptional; एते निपाताः, निपातोऽयम् &c. 
__8 A particle, an indeclinable; see [[

.]] 
__9 The opposite extremity, the lower end. 
__10 Mixing, coming together; बिन्दुन्यासादयोऽवस्थाः शुक्रशोणितसंभवाः । यासामेव निपातेन कललं नाम जायते ॥ [[

a. Killing, destroying. 
-नम् 
__1 Throwing down, beating or knocking down; अवगूर्य चरेत् कृच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रं निपातने [[

.]] 
__2 Overthrowing, destroying, killing; माषकस्तु भवेद्दण्डः श्वसूकरनिपातने [[

.]] 
__3 Touching with. 
__4 Putting down as irregular or exceptional. 
__5 An irregular form of a word, irregularity, exception; यल्लक्षणेनानुत्पन्नं तत् सर्वं निपातनात् सिद्धम् [[Mbh.]] 
__6 Falling or flying down.

a. 
__1 Thrown or put down, felled. 
__2 Killed, destroyed. 
__3 Beaten down. 
__4 Irregular.
ind. Ved. Without speaking (like a tree without foliage).

€2P. 
__1 To drink or suck in, imbibe. 
__2 To absorb, dry up. 
__3 To drink, kiss; अत एव निपीयतेऽधरः [[

]]; दन्तच्छदं प्रियतमेन निपीतसारम् [[Ṛs. 4. 13.]] 
__4 To feast on (with the eyes or ears).

a. Situated low, deep. 
-पः 
__1 The foot of a mountain. 
__2 A kind of कदम्ब (said to blossom in the rainy season; Adina Cordifolia Hook). The tree is known as हेडु or हेडकदम्ब in Marāthī. It is the same as हरिद्रकदम्बक or हरिद्रक. The wood of the tree is yellow and is still found employed in old buildings. नीपः प्रदीपायते [[
]]; सीमन्ते च त्बदुपगमजं यत्र नीपं वधूनाम् [[

]]; नवनीपाङ्कुरनन्दनीयशोभा [[Bhār. Ch.]] 
__3 A species of Aśoka; a kind of plant (Mar. दुपारी); कदम्बवेतसनलनीपवञ्जुलकैर्वृतम् (पयः) [[

.]] 
__4 N. of a family of kings; नीपान्वयः पार्थिव एष यज्वा [[

.]] 
-पम् The flower of the Kadamba tree; नीपं दृष्ट्वा हरितकपिशं कैसरैरर्धरूढैः [[

__1 Drinking. 
__2 Any reservoir of water, pool, puddle; गाहन्तां महिषा निपानसलिलं शृङ्गैर्मुहुस्ताडितम् [[Ś. 2. 6]]; [[
]]; निपानवत् स कमलचारुदीर्घिकं ददर्श तद् वनमिव नन्दनं वनम् [[Bu.

.]] 
__3 A place or trough near a well for watering cattle. 
__4 A well; जह्युः स्वराडिव निपानखनित्रमिन्द्रः [[

.]] 
__5 A milkpail. 
__6 A resort, place of shelter; निपानं सर्वभूतानाम् [[
p. p. Drunk in, absorbed, dried up.

__1 Maturing, ripening. 
__2 Cooking. 
__3 Perspiration. 
__4 The result of a bad action; निपाकः पचने स्वेदेऽप्यसत्कर्मफलेऽपि च [[Nm.]]

Ved. 
__1 Low ground. 
__2 High and low ground.

.]] 
__2 To press together, squeeze. 
__3 To seize, grasp, hold fast, embrace; गुरोः सदारस्य निपीड्य पादौ [[

__2 Hurting, injuring.

p. p. 
__1 Squeezed, pressed. 
__2 Pained, hurt. 
__3 Embraced.

a.

.]] 
__2 Proficient or skilled in, conversant or familiar with (with loc. or instr.); वाचि [Page0901-2] निपुणः; वाचा निपुणः. 
__3 Experienced. 
__4 Kindly or friendly towards. 
__5 Acute, fine, delicate, minute, sharp. 
__6 Complete, perfect, accurate.

.]]

.]]
